additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425627-DC/Si-D/AT- Router 2 configuration CRM:02889000003
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
Sorry, I forgot to get back to you yesterday. So the commissioning was successful after all. The customer had forgotten that a load management system was installed, so the OCPP URL given was the wrong one. Everything worked with the correct one.
The ticket can be closed.
Thank you for your help.
BR
Daniel
